scamShield.title: Senior Scam Shield
scamShield.subtitle: Know the tricks. Stay safe. Ask your family when in doubt.
scamShield.premiumNote: Premium families get new scam alerts as they appear.

deepfake.title: Deepfake video calls
deepfake.summary: A scammer uses AI to copy the face and voice of someone you love and asks for urgent money.
do: Hang up and call your relative on their usual number
Agree on a secret family question or code word
Ask something only the real person would know
dont: Don't send money because of a video call alone
Don't trust a face or voice just because it looks and sounds right

bank.title: Fake bank texts and links
bank.summary: A message says your account is locked or suspicious and sends a link to "fix" it.
do: Open your bank app yourself, or call the number on the back of your card
Check the sender and the web address carefully
Show the message to a family member first
dont: Don't tap links in text messages
Don't share your OTP, PIN or password with anyone, not even "the bank"
Don't install apps sent to you in a message

police.title: Fake police or government calls
police.summary: A caller claims you are involved in a crime and demands you move money to a "safe account".
do: Hang up and call the police on the official number
Remember: real officials never ask for money transfers by phone
Tell a family member right away
dont: Don't transfer money to a "safe account"
Don't share ID numbers or bank details by phone
Don't keep the call a secret

pwa.body: Open it like a real app: full screen, no browser bar.

steps: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
